title: Étale deformation chart and its smooth projection
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, let $d\geq0$, put $C=A[x_1,\ldots,x_d]$, and let $C\to R$ be an étale ring map (so the induced affine-scheme morphism is étale [def-weil-etale-morphism]). Write $I=(x_1,\ldots,x_d)R$, $E=C[t,x_1/t,\ldots,x_d/t]\subseteq C[t,t^{-1}]$, and $D=R[t,I/t]\subseteq R[t,t^{-1}]$. The canonical map $R\otimes_C E\to D$ is an isomorphism. Under $E\cong A[t,u_1,\ldots,u_d]$ with $x_i\mapsto t u_i$, using affine spectra [def-weil-affine-spectrum], the induced map $\operatorname{Spec}D\to\operatorname{Spec}A[t,u_1,\ldots,u_d]$ is étale, and its composite with the affine-space projection [def-sbc-affine-space] $\operatorname{Spec}A[t,u_1,\ldots,u_d]\to\operatorname{Spec}A[t]$ is smooth of relative dimension $d$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms].

proof.text: Use the already proved Ideal.mvPolynomialExtendedReesAlgebraEquiv and its comp_C equation for the polynomial presentation. For the inverse-coordinate formula apply this injective equivalence, then Subtype.ext, and calculate t*(x_i*t^(-1))=x_i using mvPolynomialToLaurent_C, mvPolynomialToLaurent_X and Laurent monomial multiplication. This works over every commutative coefficient ring.

proof.text: The etale hypothesis gives Algebra.Etale C R, hence Module.Flat C R. Apply the already proved source-library theorem Ideal.isBaseChange_extendedReesAlgebraAlgHom R. Its proof tensors the subalgebra inclusion into Laurent polynomials, uses flat tensor injectivity, identifies the ambient Laurent tensor product, and proves surjectivity by the generators of the mapped ideal. Compare its linear equivalence with etaleReesTensorMap by tensor induction; on pure tensors both are r times the functorial Rees image. Bijectivity follows from that equivalence.

proof.text: Use Ideal.isPushout_extendedReesAlgebra and symmetry to view D as the E-algebra base change E tensor_C R. Algebra.Etale.baseChange and Algebra.Etale.of_equiv along Algebra.IsPushout.equiv show E -> D is etale. Compose with the polynomial-origin ring equivalence and the two ULift ring equivalences. A private proved helper uses algebraize and Algebra.Etale.comp so that the ring universes can be different. HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff converts this ring result into the required etale scheme morphism. No explicit chosen affine pullback is needed.

proof.text: Apply the proved source instance MvPolynomial.isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension to A[t][u_i] over A[t], with Nat.card (Fin d)=d. Transport standard smoothness through the two ULift ring equivalences using RingHom.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension.equiv and comp, then use RingHom.locally_of and HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff for the lifted affine projection. Mathlib already gives SmoothOfRelativeDimension 0 for the etale chart. Apply smoothOfRelativeDimension_comp and simplify 0+d=d. These are the same polynomial chart and relative-dimension composition as the blueprint, without a separate fibre-dimension comparison.

lean.statement: theorem etale_rees_chart (A : Type u) (R : Type v) [CommRing A] [CommRing R] (d : ℕ) [Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin d) A) R] (he : (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin d) A) R).Etale) : ((Ideal.mvPolynomialExtendedReesAlgebraEquiv A (Fin d)).toRingHom.comp (MvPolynomial.C : Polynomial A →+* MvPolynomial (Fin d) (Polynomial A)) = (Ideal.mvPolynomialOrigin A (Fin d)).toExtendedReesAlgebra.comp (Polynomial.mapRingHom (MvPolynomial.C : A →+* MvPolynomial (Fin d) A))) ∧ (∀ i : Fin d, (Ideal.mvPolynomialExtendedReesAlgebraEquiv A (Fin d)).symm (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin d) A) (Ideal.mvPolynomialOrigin A (Fin d)).extendedReesAlgebra (MvPolynomial.X i)) = MvPolynomial.C Polynomial.X * MvPolynomial.X i) ∧ Function.Bijective (etaleReesTensorMap A R d) ∧ (∀ (r : R) (z : (Ideal.mvPolynomialOrigin A (Fin d)).extendedReesAlgebra), ((etaleReesTensorMap A R d) (r ⊗ₜ z) : LaurentPolynomial R) = LaurentPolynomial.C r * LaurentPolynomial.mapRingHom (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin d) A) R) (z : LaurentPolynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin d) A))) ∧ AlgebraicGeometry.Etale (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (etaleReesChartSchemeMap A R d))) ∧ AlgebraicGeometry.SmoothOfRelativeDimension d (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (etaleReesChartSchemeMap A R d)) ≫ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (etaleReesBaseSchemeMap A R d)))
